title: Terminal preflight failures without an input record do not block acceptance admission
outcome: A registered launcher run that failed coherently before input capture or any stage is recognized as never started, without weakening genuine failure or newest-result selection.
acceptance: A coherent terminal failed launcher result with no input member and an explicit list of unrun stages with no start timestamp is classified as NotStarted, so it does not block a complete never-started-only claim from taking the legacy evaluation flow.

Such a never-started result does not prevent selection of an older applicable eligible run, while a genuinely started newer failure still supersedes an older pass and missing or incoherent results still refuse admission.

Behavioral tests through committed-input admission cover the terminal preflight-failure shape, legacy and eligible-run selection, genuine newer failures, and ambiguous missing-input results without changing historical run artifacts.
